 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 11.09.2024 1.

This petition seeks quashing of FIR No.504/2021 registered at P.S. Farsh Bazar, Delhi under Section 67 of the IT Act and under Sections 498A/406/34 of IPC qua the petitioner basis settlement arrived at between the parties dated 31st August 2024, which is on record of this Court.
2. Petitioner and respondent no.2/complainant are present in Court and are duly identified by the IO and the counsel.
3. Respondent no.2, who is wife of petitioner, states that she has amicably resolved her disputes with her petitioner-husband and has no objection to quashing of FIR qua him.
4. APP for the State submits that there is another accused namely Arti Paliwal who has been arrayed, but there is no settlement qua her.
This aspect is confirmed by respondent no.2.

Consequently, the FIR No.504/2021 registered at P.S. Farsh Bazar, Delhi under Section 67 of the IT Act and under Sections 498A/406/34 of IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed qua the present petitioner.
